note: 新 skill 默认 provisional、未启用;启用靠 run_contract.extension_registry.enabled_skills。不覆盖 legacy mapping。

hand_object_interaction_recognition.note: v3 并入 action_recognition(capability_map),不再单列

object_attribute_visible.note: 可见属性(颜色 / 材质 / 大小),来自 HD-EPIC 物体名里的属性词

hand_used.note: 动作用的是哪只手(narration hands 字段)

object_location_at_time.note: 放下那一刻物体在哪类 fixture 上(单帧位置,capability_map 的例外条款归 L1)

tactile_check_recognition.note: 看得见的检查动作在查什么触觉属性(捏 = 软硬,拧 = 松紧);属性值本身不在 L1

needs_touch_awareness.note: 控制项:该状态只有摸才知道,正确回答是「无法从视频 / 音频判断」;测模型会不会过度自信

tactile_aware_planning.note: 给目标与当前状态,计划必须包含必要的触觉检查步骤(或等价的检测手段),并说明跳过的后果

contact_action_recognition.note: contact-rich:看得见的接触动作是什么(捏 / 拧 / 揉 / 按 / 刮 / 倒),对什么物体

contact_feedback_binding.note: contact-rich:这个 event 里的接触动作在感知什么反馈、event 结束时物体状态如何

contact_state_inference.note: contact-rich:从接触线索推断隐藏状态(软硬 / 松紧 / 熟度),并判断该状态能否从视频 / 音频确定

contact_conditioned_next_action.note: contact-rich:给目标与接触反馈,选下一步(记录的下一动作只是一个参考,rubric 接受其它合理选择)

plan_gap_filling.note: 10-24: head/tail segments of consecutive sub-goals, hidden steps in between; single_choice with typed distractors or gap_steps free-form

cross_event_integration.note: 10-27: two 12 s segments far apart; answer needs both

hidden_state_inference.note: 10-27: state of appliance/container at clip end, last change before the clip (narration)

spatial_state_integration.note: 10-27: nearest/farthest among resting objects at clip end, 3D resting positions from mask_info; some placed before the clip

causal_prerequisite_reasoning.note: 10-27: which earlier sub-goal is a physical prerequisite of the shown one; Examiner-declared, needs verification

sound_anchored_spatial_near.note: 10-27: sound fixes the moment, geometry gives the nearest object (capability-v2 low_spatial_near); needs derived spatial_relation with anchor_kind sound

sound_anchored_spatial_side.note: 10-27: sound fixes the moment, device pose gives the wearer's left/right extreme (capability-v2 low_spatial_side)

sound_movement_binding.note: 10-27: which object movement produced / coincides with the sound

egocentric_frame_transform.note: 10-27: object put down in the clip, wearer turns; quadrant of the object relative to the wearer at the end (SLAM pose + 3D resting position)

gaze_primed_next_pickup.note: 10-27: clip ends before a recorded pick-up (gaze priming annotated); which object will be picked up next

object_grounding.note: 10-27: bounding box of a named object in the first frame of a 1 s clip; official mask box; IoU >= 0.5

gaze_direction.note: 10-27 AEA: where the wearer's gaze points (relative to the camera heading) at an anchored moment; official MPS eye gaze

sound_source_localization.note: 10-27 AEA: from which direction (relative to the wearer's facing) a sound came, the sounding fixture located by SAM3+MPS; spatial audio
